# Standing rules

## Composition and phases

### Every change runs as a train (0001-TST-PLT, 2026-01-01)

Every change runs as a train, with one plan per body of work.

Amended by 0004-TST-PLT (Ledger rows are appended under a lock).

## The jail and grammars

### The jail refuses network tools for workers (see `curl`, `wget`) (0002-TST-PLT, 2026-01-02)

The jail refuses network tools for workers (see `curl`, `wget`): the hook checks the command word.

Amended by 0006-TST-PLT (Workers read during a train).

### Workers read during a train (0006-TST-PLT, 2026-01-06)

Workers read during a train. A worker may read another agent's files, never write them.

## The ledger and charter

### Ledger rows are appended under a lock (0004-TST-PLT, 2026-01-04)

Ledger rows are appended under a lock; the lock lives in the owning project.

### Pipe escape kept (0008-TST-PLT, 2026-01-08)

Pipe escape kept. A cell may carry an escaped \| pipe.

## GitHub and release

### Only the conductor pushes (0005-TST-PLT, 2026-01-05)

Only the conductor pushes, and the operator merges.

## Operator interaction

### Warn the operator, never block main (0007-TST-PLT, 2026-01-07)

Warn the operator, never block main. The main session is warned and keeps working.

## Superseded

- Coders push their own branches (0003-TST-PLT), superseded by 0005-TST-PLT.
